title: Probability and Statistics
description: Use probability theory to model uncertainty, design simple probabilistic models that facilitate prediction, conduct sound scientific analysis of data, and study the foundations of probabilistic modelling with Markov chains and simulation.
learning_objectives: Describe notions of probability in terms of sample spaces
Design simple probability models and estimate their parameters from data
Perform hypothesis tests and draw scientific conclusions
topics: Discrete random variables and their probability distributions
Continuous random variables and their probability distributions
